visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with braids wearing a green sleeveless dress stands in a brightly lit shopping mall, speaking directly to the camera with expressive facial movements and hand gestures. Behind her is a lush green indoor plant display and a black grand piano positioned on a simulated mossy floor. The environment is clean and modern, with retail storefronts visible in the background. (2) The camera pans and cuts to close-up shots of the black grand piano, showing the 'YAMAHA' brand logo and a small sign placed on the lid. The woman continues to speak, appearing in small circular overlays or in full frame, explaining the setting. The lighting is consistent, bright, and even across the mall interior. (3) A brief montage shows the woman playing pianos in different settings, including one with a 'Hong Kong' flag icon and another with a 'Japan' flag icon, before cutting to a video clip of a male singer on a screen. She then returns to the mall setting, looking excited and enthusiastic as she introduces the song she is about to play. (4) The woman sits at the grand piano and begins to play. The camera uses various angles including a side profile, a top-down view of her hands on the black and white keys, and reflections on the piano's polished surface. Various mall visitors, including a woman with a child and a man in a white shirt, are seen walking past or stopping to observe the performance. (5) The performance concludes with the woman finishing the piece with a flourish of her hands. She turns to the camera with a wide smile and a satisfied expression, maintaining her position on the piano bench while the mall environment continues its usual activity behind her.
